title: Site settings
description: What appears on every page of the site. Switch language to translate each text.

saved.title: Settings saved
saved.description: The changes are saved in the draft. Publish the site to put them live.

failed.title: Could not save the settings
failed.description: Your changes are still here. Check your connection and try again.

general.title: General
general.description: The basics every page shares: the site's name and the image used when a link is shared.

siteName.title: Site name
siteName.description: Shown in the header, the browser tab and search results.

defaultSocialImage.title: Default social image
defaultSocialImage.description: Used when a page shares a link without an image of its own.

defaultDescription.title: Default description
defaultDescription.description: Used when a page has no description of its own.

header.title: Header
header.description: What opens every page that shows it. Its fields come from this site’s header block.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: What closes every page that shows it. Its fields come from this site’s footer block.

variant.label: Design
variant.description: The site offers more than one. Changing it starts the fields from scratch.

replace.title: Replace the saved design?
replace.description: This slot currently saves the "{{stored}}" design. Saving "{{chosen}}" replaces it, and what was entered in "{{stored}}" is lost.

publish.title: Publish site
publish.description: Saving a change updates the draft only. Publish the site to put the header, footer, site name and defaults on every page.

hint.never: Visitors see pages without the header, footer or site name until you publish.
hint.changes: The site still shows what {{name}} published on {{when}}. Publish to put your saved changes live.

problems.title: The site cannot be published yet
problems.unknown_block: {{place}} holds a block this site no longer offers. Choose another design and save.
problems.invalid_content: {{place}} has content that is not valid. Fix it and save.
problems.unknown_media: {{place}} uses an image that was removed from the media library.
problems.missing_default_locale: {{place}} has no value in the default language for {{path}}. Fill it in, then save.
